note: Display metadata for kiosk products. Numeric keys map quicktill stockline_id to metadata and win over name matching. The 'names' map matches case-insensitive substrings of the product name so metadata survives stockline renumbering — first matching key wins, keep specific keys before generic ones. model (can|ball|bottle), color/color2, label and logo/logo2 tune the 3D product model; image swaps in a flat picture instead. Logos fall back to the text label until the file exists in public/images/brands/ — see README. All fields optional.
